# Extracted Entity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ExtractedEntity`](gmeow-ExtractedEntity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ExtractedEntity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/graphrag`](../../slices/graphrag.md)

A model-extracted entity DESCRIPTION — an information object about a putative entity, derived from source chunks. Deliberately NOT the entity itself: promotion to a first-class [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md) (with coreference by reference, never [owl:sameAs](http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#sameAs) — P5) is a separate, attributable curation act.
